speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The final major environmental concern is the effect of construction noise on marine life.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Construction noise can seriously disturb fish and marine mammals.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: We therefore need to reduce underwater noise as much as possible during construction.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The available technologies differ in cost, environmental effectiveness and technical certainty.
